text: In my city, everyone is serious.
My neighbor says: Stop it, the whole house is shaking.
Then this poster shows up everywhere. The big Dance Battle.
Everyone laughs at me. Him? He'll trip in five seconds.
The big day. The best dancers in the whole region.
The reigning champion. Ninety-nine moves. Never lost.
After one hour, the first guy twists his ankle. Out.
Then someone drops a banana. Even the champion slips.
The robot. The moonwalk. A backflip. Easy.
And everyone who laughed at me? They're bowing now.
Tomorrow they're serious again. And me? I just keep dancing.
